The course runs from MYP1 to DP2. Every year you work on shared units with the rest of your class, and every year you also grow
in your own direction. Day-to-day lessons are on the [class site](https://classes.seancoleman.org). Click any heading to fold
its section.

## Three pages

::: {.crs}
::: {.en-grid}
::: {.en-opt}
#### [Your Pathway](pathway.qmd)
Pick your unit and see, for each strand of the rubric, what you already know, the one new skill this unit adds, and where it
goes next. Tick what you can do.
:::
::: {.en-opt}
#### [Enrichment](enrichment.qmd)
The common core everyone does, and the options you choose as performer, creator, producer, technician, reader or researcher,
with your growth through the Music Learning Theory levels.
:::
::: {.en-opt}
#### [Glossary](glossary.qmd)
Music vocabulary, MYP concepts and command terms, DP Music terms with TOK connections, and Music Learning Theory. Filter by
your year.
:::
:::
:::

## The years at a glance

| Year | Rubric | What is new | Your decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| MYP1 | Year 1 | The first whole cycle: research from sources, an intention sentence, a performance, strength and limitation. | |
| MYP2 | Year 3 | The verbs step up: analyse, explain. Time stamps, reasons, ensemble playing. | |
| MYP3 | Year 3 | Feature and effect, tried–problem–decided, a DAW track from your own material. | Continue music in MYP4? |
| MYP4 | Year 5 | Every strand steps up: critique, justify, evaluate thoroughly, discuss. | Do the ePortfolio in MYP5? |
| MYP5 | Year 5 | A full practice run of the ePortfolio, then the ePortfolio for those who choose it. | DP Music? SL or HL? |
| DP1–DP2 | DP | Researcher, creator and performer across four areas of inquiry; HL adds the contemporary music-maker. | |

The DP Music course changes in fall 2028. This year's MYP5 class takes the current course; students who start DP in 2028 or
later will take the new one, whose details come out in early 2028.

## Shared links and your data

Your ticks and choices are saved only in the browser you use. Each page has a **share link** that holds them, so you can send
your plan to your teacher or open it on another device. Nothing is sent anywhere until you share the link yourself.
